title: Apple Pie Overnight Oats
changes_from_base: Uncooked: rolled oats and chia soak overnight in spiced vanilla milk in jars and are layered with butter-softened apples tossed in a home-made apple pie spice mix.
summary: Apple pie flavours are captured in these convenient jars of creamy overnight oats, studded with tender spiced fruit and held together by ancient grains and seeds.
equipment: 6 jars or glasses (about 300 ml each) with lids

ingredients.item: eating apples (about 2), cored and cut in 1 cm dice
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast spices
steps.text: Whisk together 2 tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp ginger, ⅛ tsp allspice and ⅛ tsp cardamom in a small bowl.

steps.title: Cook apples
steps.text: Melt 14 g butter in a frying pan over medium heat, add 400 g diced apple (about 1 cm), 28 g brown sugar, ⅛ tsp salt and 2 tsp spice mix; cook 5-8 min stirring until just tender, then cool.

steps.title: Make soak
steps.text: In a large jug whisk 720 ml milk, 1 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp vanilla, ⅛ tsp salt and the remaining spice mix, then stir in 180 g rolled oats and 3 tbsp chia seeds.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Divide half the oat mixture between 6 jars, add half the apples, repeat the layers.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate at least 8 h, stirring well before eating either cold or warmed.

tips: Prepare the spiced apples the evening before to save time in the morning.
These jars transport well, making them perfect for breakfasts on the go.
Warm them gently in the microwave or pour into a pan if you prefer hot porridge.
storage: Keep chilled for up to 4 days; stir well before eating, serve cold or reheat gently. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
